summary: At Arcana, we understand technology networks and what drives businesses forward. From cloud-native platforms and data-driven solutions to DevOps automation, enterprise-scale services, infrastructure, and digital transformation, we deliver a broad portfolio of innovative solutions.
responsibilities: Ensure smooth code integration with CI/CD pipelines
Optimize release management and automate deployment environments
Create and manage a cloud strategy (GPS, Azure and on-premise)
Standardize the software development release management process
Troubleshoot and provide technical support and guidance
Guide users on best practices for container-based applications
required_skills: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related engineering field
Strong background in DevOps with hands-on configuration and deployment
Knowledge of Ansible, Terraform, Python, and scripting (PowerShell/Python/Bash)
Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes (CKA certification is a plus)
Experience with Azure cloud-based provisioning, deployment, and monitoring
Understanding of platform security best practices
Proficiency in source control/configuration management including Git and GitLab; familiarity with Azure DevOps and Visual Studio Code is a plus
nice_to_have_skills: Collaborative spirit with proven capabilities in working with international teams
Experience working with data engineering and data science teams is a plus
